title: Brandenburg Concertos
notes: Six concertos, each for a different ensemble; No. 5 seeds the keyboard concerto.

title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book I
notes: 24 preludes and fugues through every key, written partly for teaching.

title: St Matthew Passion
notes: Double choir and orchestra stage the Passion; its 1829 revival relaunched Bach.

title: Goldberg Variations
notes: Aria and thirty variations over one bass line, canons every third variation.

title: Cello Suites
notes: Six solo suites, prelude plus dances; resonant open strings, dark Fifth.
